House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Greater Litchfield Opera House Association.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; LITCHFIELD OPERA HOUSE. +]

[+$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Greater Litchfield Opera House Association for expanding and installing balcony seating. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Greater Litchfield Opera House Association.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LITCHFIELD OPERA HOUSE.

$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Greater Litchfield Opera House Association for expanding and installing balcony seating.
additions: $50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for a grant to the Greater Litchfield Opera House Association for expanding and installing balcony seating.
